To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Knowledge management infrastructure and processes are the key determinants of the effectiveness of nursing practice.

(1) knowledge infrastructure and process have a positive influence on nursing care effectiveness; and (2) the knowledge infrastructure and process are the main factors that affect the efficiency of nursing care.
knowledge infrastructure and knowledge processes are important to enhance the effectiveness of nursing practice and the quality of patient care in clinical nursing.
